description: Exhaustive inventory of every persisted TaskProgress field (plan §3.10) and every production consumer of the permissive legacy progress reader/writer in utils/taskProgressUtils (plan §3.12 step 1). Mechanically regenerated by scripts/generateTaskProgressFieldInventory.mjs --generate; policy attributes and cohort assignments are human-authored and preserved across regeneration. verify:task-progress-fields fails on any TaskProgress field without a row, any stale row, any missing/unattributed policy rule, and any unlisted permissive-reader consumer. Lifecycle rules quoted from plan §3.11's table where that table defines the field; the six fields the plan table omits (archivedFrom, pinnedAt, publishScopePath, fallbackModelId, reviewScoreHistory, escalation) now carry the policy rows authored with the Foundations field-policy module (src/services/taskProgressFieldPolicyV1.ts, whose Record type over every persisted field is the compile-time half of the completeness check; this inventory is the generated half). V1 decoder rules are implemented by src/services/taskProgressDecoderV1.ts and exercised by src/test/taskProgressDecoderV1.test.ts + test-fixtures/task-progress/**.
generatedFrom: src/types/taskProgress.ts (TaskProgress interface) + production imports of utils/taskProgressUtils

fields.name: taskFolder
fields.historicalFamilyRule: Present in every historical family; must equal the discovered task folder name.
fields.v1DecoderRule: Required bounded non-empty string; must equal the discovered folder when the caller provides expectedTaskFolder (taskProgressDecoderV1), else taskFolderMismatch recovery.

lifecyclePolicy.migration: Validate against the discovered task folder; set once for new tasks (§3.11).

fields.name: displayName
fields.historicalFamilyRule: Optional in every family; absence means the generated default label is in use.
fields.v1DecoderRule: Optional bounded string (≤4096 chars).

lifecyclePolicy.migration: Validate according to current optionality; set from creation input/default (§3.11).

fields.name: nameIsDefault
fields.historicalFamilyRule: Optional exact boolean in every family; no coercion from truthy values.
fields.v1DecoderRule: Optional exact boolean; any other type is recovery (no coercion).

lifecyclePolicy.migration: Validate exact boolean/current optionality; derive during creation (§3.11).

fields.name: currentStage
fields.historicalFamilyRule: Present in every family; must be one valid canonical stage (historical aliases resolve through the stage canonicalization the permissive reader applies today).
fields.v1DecoderRule: Required string; canonical stage for ensemble-v1; the legacy family additionally resolves the closed alias table and the synthetic "completed" stage → publish. Anything else is invalidFieldValue recovery — never coerced to desc.

lifecyclePolicy.migration: Preserve one valid canonical stage; new task uses first stage (§3.11).

fields.name: status
fields.historicalFamilyRule: Missing means active (backward compat, per the field's own doc comment); otherwise one valid TaskStatus.
fields.v1DecoderRule: Optional canonical TaskStatus (absence materializes active); the legacy family also accepts finished/done → completed, but only when completedAt is present — a synthesized timestamp would be coercion, so its absence is recovery.

lifecyclePolicy.migration: Preserve valid historical state; new task starts creating (§3.11).

fields.name: completedAt
fields.historicalFamilyRule: Optional ISO string preserved as inert historical metadata with ANY status — completion is inferred solely from status, never from this field (declaration doc; archiveTask.ts and resumeArchivedTask persist archived/active documents that keep completedAt).
fields.v1DecoderRule: Optional ISO timestamp, preserved as inert history regardless of status; no cross-field status rejection (the earlier presence-with-non-completed-status recovery rule rejected the documented output of resumeArchivedTask — corrected per implementation review).

lifecyclePolicy.migration: Validate ISO timestamp; preserve as inert historical metadata with any status (§3.11, amended per implementation review — archive/resume preserve it).

fields.name: archivedFrom
fields.historicalFamilyRule: Optional exact TaskStatus recorded at archive time; omit-compatible (older files simply lack it); resuming an archived task always returns to active regardless of this value (declaration doc).
fields.v1DecoderRule: Optional exact TaskStatus; unrecognized values are recovery.

lifecyclePolicy.migration: Validate exact TaskStatus; preserve as archival history (taskProgressFieldPolicyV1).
lifecyclePolicy.nextStage: Preserve (archival history; the archive surface, not a lifecycle transition, owns it) (taskProgressFieldPolicyV1).

fields.name: pinnedAt
fields.historicalFamilyRule: Optional ISO timestamp present only while pinned; omit-compatible; survives lifecycle transitions (declaration doc).
fields.v1DecoderRule: Optional ISO timestamp.

lifecyclePolicy.migration: Validate ISO timestamp; preserve (taskProgressFieldPolicyV1).

fields.name: publishScopePath
fields.historicalFamilyRule: Optional workspace-relative project root the Publish stage verifies against; omit-compatible; persists across transitions (declaration doc).
fields.v1DecoderRule: Optional bounded string (≤1024 chars).

lifecyclePolicy.migration: Validate bounded string; preserve (taskProgressFieldPolicyV1).

fields.name: completedStages
fields.historicalFamilyRule: Optional array of known unique stages; the only production writer (markTaskDone.ts:190) records just the terminal ["publish"] tick, so gapped sets are the shipped shape, not corruption.
fields.v1DecoderRule: Optional array of unique recognized stages (legacy aliases resolve for the legacy family); canonicalized to the contiguous STAGE_ORDER prefix through the highest recorded stage, backfilling earlier stages (the earlier reject-gaps rule sent every markTaskDone-completed task to recovery — corrected per implementation review). Duplicates after canonicalization and unknown stages are recovery.

lifecyclePolicy.migration: Validate known unique stages and canonicalize to a prefix, backfilling through the highest recorded tick (§3.11).
lifecyclePolicy.reopen: Retain only stages strictly before selected stage (§3.11).

fields.name: preImageDescription
fields.historicalFamilyRule: Optional bounded text; present only for tasks whose description was AI-drafted after the field was introduced.
fields.v1DecoderRule: Optional bounded string (≤256 KiB).

lifecyclePolicy.migration: Validate bounded current representation; preserve or omit according to historical family (§3.11).

fields.name: ownership
fields.typeText: { metaRoot: string; projectRoot: string; workspaceRoot?: string; boundAt: string; state?: "resolved" | "ownership-unresolved"; }
fields.historicalFamilyRule: Persisted project/meta-root binding; families predating the field legitimately lack it. Never treated as an operation lease and never cleared by stage transitions, completion, or reopen (plan product decisions).
fields.v1DecoderRule: Optional exact-shape binding: non-empty metaRoot/projectRoot, ISO boundAt, optional non-empty workspaceRoot, optional state enum; unknown nested keys are recovery.

lifecyclePolicy.migration: Preserve validated project/meta-root binding; if a historical family legitimately lacks it, resolve only from one unambiguous current binding or enter recovery (§3.11).

fields.name: createdAt
fields.historicalFamilyRule: Present ISO timestamp in every family.
fields.v1DecoderRule: Required ISO timestamp.

lifecyclePolicy.migration: Validate and preserve; new task sets once (§3.11).

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.historicalFamilyRule: Present ISO timestamp in every family.
fields.v1DecoderRule: Required ISO timestamp.

lifecyclePolicy.migration: Validate/preserve on format-only migration; new task sets coordinator time (§3.11).

fields.name: implReviewFiles
fields.historicalFamilyRule: Absent for tasks implemented manually or created before the field existed (falls back to open-editor review scope, per declaration doc).
fields.v1DecoderRule: Optional bounded array (≤4096 entries) of bounded non-empty strings; non-string entries are recovery, never silently filtered like the permissive reader does.

lifecyclePolicy.migration: Validate bounded task-local review references; map absence only where its historical family permits (§3.11).
lifecyclePolicy.reopen: Preserve only when its owner stage is strictly before selected stage; otherwise [] (§3.11).

fields.name: lintPayload
fields.historicalFamilyRule: Present only after a lint run for a completed task; absent means lint state unknown (declaration doc).
fields.v1DecoderRule: Optional exact shape: ISO runAt, boolean passed, optional bounded summary, optional non-negative integer issueCount, optional bounded failedChecks entries; unknown nested keys are recovery.

lifecyclePolicy.migration: Validate/preserve without granting runtime ownership (§3.11).

fields.name: scheduledRun
fields.typeText: { runAt: string; stage: TaskStage; leaseOwner?: string; leaseUntil?: string; }
fields.historicalFamilyRule: One-shot schedule record; must be internally consistent (runAt/stage, optional lease pair).
fields.v1DecoderRule: Optional exact shape: ISO runAt, recognized stage, optional bounded non-empty leaseOwner, optional ISO leaseUntil; unknown nested keys are recovery.

lifecyclePolicy.migration: Validate with companion fields; inconsistent combinations recover (§3.11).

fields.name: scheduledResumeTime
fields.historicalFamilyRule: Deprecated alias kept readable for schedules created by older releases (declaration doc).
fields.v1DecoderRule: Optional ISO timestamp; presence together with scheduledRun is conflictingAliases recovery.

lifecyclePolicy.migration: Validate with scheduledRun; no coercion (§3.11).

fields.name: fallbackActive
fields.historicalFamilyRule: Existing per-stage map only; scalar boolean input is invalid (plan product decisions).
fields.v1DecoderRule: Per-stage boolean map only, via decodeFallbackStateV1; scalar booleans, unknown stage keys, and non-boolean entries are recovery.

lifecyclePolicy.migration: Decode only the existing per-stage map; reject scalar booleans; new tasks use the current map factory/default (§3.11).
lifecyclePolicy.nextStage: Set the departing-stage entry to false where an entry exists; retain other valid stage entries; never materialize entries for absent stages (§3.11, refined for parity with clearStageFallbackReservation).
lifecyclePolicy.markTaskDone: Set the current-stage entry to false where an entry exists; never materialize entries for absent stages (§3.11, refined for parity with clearStageFallbackReservation).
lifecyclePolicy.reopen: Set selected and later-stage entries to false where an entry exists; retain earlier entries; never materialize entries for absent stages (§3.11, refined for parity with clearStageFallbackReservation).

fields.name: fallbackModelId
fields.historicalFamilyRule: Optional per-stage backup-model map recorded while a fallback carries a stage; canonical stage keys only; omit-compatible.
fields.v1DecoderRule: Optional per-stage map of bounded non-empty model-id strings with canonical stage keys only; anything else is recovery.

lifecyclePolicy.migration: Validate per-stage map of bounded non-empty model-id strings with canonical stage keys only (taskProgressFieldPolicyV1).
lifecyclePolicy.nextStage: Clear the departing-stage entry; retain other entries (companion to fallbackActive) (taskProgressFieldPolicyV1).
lifecyclePolicy.reopen: Clear selected and later-stage entries; retain earlier entries (taskProgressFieldPolicyV1).

fields.name: reviewAttemptId
fields.historicalFamilyRule: Monotonic token identifying the review run allowed to finalize a stage; inert historical state on migration.
fields.v1DecoderRule: Optional bounded non-empty string (≤256 chars).

lifecyclePolicy.migration: Validate/preserve only as inert historical state (§3.11).

fields.name: reviewScoreHistory
fields.historicalFamilyRule: Optional capped per-round review score trail appended at review publish points; omit-compatible.
fields.v1DecoderRule: Optional bounded exact-shape array (≤ MAX_REVIEW_SCORE_HISTORY entries: recognized stage, finite-or-null score, bounded attemptId, ISO at, non-negative integer counts); unknown entry keys are recovery.

lifecyclePolicy.migration: Validate bounded exact-shape entry array; preserve (taskProgressFieldPolicyV1).

fields.name: escalation
fields.historicalFamilyRule: Optional record set when automated review iteration needs a human decision; cleared on the next stage transition and explicit resume; omit-compatible.
fields.v1DecoderRule: Optional exact shape: recognized stage and escalation kind, bounded reason, ISO at, optional boolean secondOpinionAttempted; unknown nested keys are recovery.

lifecyclePolicy.migration: Validate exact shape; preserve (taskProgressFieldPolicyV1).
lifecyclePolicy.nextStage: Clear (a stage transition resolves the departing stage's stuck iteration) (taskProgressFieldPolicyV1).
